 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of bail, pending the trial.

The applicant is in custody since 05.12.2022 in connection with Crime No.117/2022, registered at P.S.-Devari, District- Raisen (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 376(2)
(N), 120-B of IPC and Section 5(1)/6 of POCSO Act.

As per the prosecution story, on 14.10.2022, mother of prosecutrix lodged an FIR stating that she is Arvind Lodhi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106628824/
1 blessed with two daughters and one son.

sentences.text: On 03.10.2022 at around 10:00 pm her middle daughter along with one Pooja had gone for darshan of Durga idol, when she did not return till 2:00 pm, she searched for her but she could not be traced, she is 17 years old.
She suspects that she might has been kidnapped by Arvind Lodhi of the village, at the pretext of marriage.
FIR for commission of offence under Section 363 of IPC was registered.
On 08.10.2022, prosecutrix along with her mother appeared at police station Devari.
Dastiabi Panchnama was registered.
After investigation, charge- sheet was filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
He has no criminal antecedent.
He is 18 years old young boy.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix has been examined before the trial Court.
S h e has turned hostile.
Even her mother has turned hostile and they have not corroborated the prosecution story.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
If he is kept in custody for unlimited period, then his future may be spoiled.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
On the other hand learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail.
I have gone through the deposition date 04.01.2023 of prosecutrix recorded before the trial Court.
She has not supported the prosecution story.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.

Therefore,
having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant/accused is not warranted.
Consequently, this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail is allowed.

It is directed that applicant- Arvind Lodhi be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for her regular appearance before the concerned Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the trial Court during the pendency of trial.

and This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
